text.body: ॥ śrīmahānandīśvarabhujaṅgastotram ॥ kirīṭendugaṅgāmanojñottamāṅgaṃ lalāṭekṣaṇātpuṣpadehānuṣaṅgaṃ । tuṣārādrikanyā sasaṅgaṃ sada'haṃ namāmyantaraṅgaṃ mahānandiliṅgam ॥ 1 digīśādidigbhittisannāṭyaliṅgaṃ lasatkumbhicarmāmbaracchāditāṅgam । jaganmātṛgaurī mukhāmbhojabhṛṅgaṃ namā॥ 2 caturvedavedyaṃ mahāvedavādyaṃ namadbhaktahṛdyaṃ murāriprasādhyam । gurubrahmabhūtaṃ cidānandarūpaṃ namā ॥ 3 purākāśikāpaṭṭaṇaprāṅgaṇānte navasvarṇadībhūtabhṛtkṛṣṭarānte । haribrahmamūrdhābhiṣiktaṃ videhaṃ namā ...॥ 4 suhṛtputrasampanmukhādyutsukhādiṃ vihāyarivargaṃ mahāsevyakāyam । jaṭājūṭamadhyapradeśapragaṅgaṃ mahībhṛddhavāṅgaṃ mahānandiliṅgam ॥ 5 caturdvāradauvārikodāryamāṇaṃ namanhṛdyagandharvagītānuraktaṃ । sunāṭyaṃ prakurvāṇamīśaṃ sureśaṃ namā ...॥ 6 ॥ iti śrīmahānandīśvara bhujaṅgastotram ॥
